interest: Reports 1943-44 Japanese industrial working hours via German press intelligence.
overview: August 1944 Bern telegram gives German-press data on Japanese industrial working hours by sector, comparing April 1943 and April 1944.

subfiles.about: Incoming telegram reporting average daily working hours of laborers in Japanese industries in April 1944 compared to April 1943 based on German press reports citing the Tokyo industrial chamber.
subfiles.summary: Bern telegram relays German press citing Tokyo's industrial chamber: average Japanese industrial working time was 10 hours 29 minutes in April 1944, with comparative sector averages for textiles, metal, machinery, ceramics, chemicals, food, clothing, and woodworking between April 1943 and April 1944.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Bern on Working Hours in Japanese Industry
